crossRefs.note: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with…
Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown…
Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and…
Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good…
I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

translations.web: for by wise guidance you wage your war; and victory is in many advisors.
translations.bsb: Only with sound guidance should you wage war, and victory lies in a multitude of counselors.
translations.kjv: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
translations.asv: For by wise guidance thou shalt make thy war; And in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
